title: Decide first-send handling of historical acceptance targets after fingerprint capture retirement
outcome: Choose and implement an explicit policy for unsent historical targets carrying a content-v1 fingerprint once that fingerprint can no longer be captured, preserving exact Pending/Unconfirmed replay and all stored evaluations.
acceptance: The chosen behavior for a first submission of an old target is documented and tested against changed, unchanged and unavailable source, without recapturing content-v1 or rewriting stored records.
Already Pending and Unconfirmed submissions continue replaying their exact original argv and digest.
